Definition: to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as a nest
BiblicalUsage: To nest is the word for making a home in the heights: the birds make their nests in the fir trees, the great owl shall make her nest in the ruins of Edom, and the inhabitant of Lebanon makest thy nest in the cedars.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the nest as the small home God provides, even in the ruins, and the cedar nest as the false safety of a king who trusted in height.
